name: BN6's redrawn effects 0x01 and 0x02
why: Effects 0x01 and 0x02 as BN6's engine spawns its own (a RockCube's placement, BN6's own chip, 0x02; a hit's spark by the hit pass, 0x01): the same record in both games (its list, number, animation and palette), its sprite BN6's redrawn bytes (tools/xsoul.py's redrawn test, the reason the Souls' code spawns BN5's copy of 0x02 at 0xC7): its frames' sprite data read from each game's own sprite.
evidence: the effects' tables: BN5 0x080DFD7C and BN6 0x080E16D4, entries 0x01 and 0x02 the same four bytes in both
